name: Aviya Mattress
description: US mattress brand selling premium hybrid mattresses that combine pocketed innerspring coils with plant-based cooling foams, direct through AviyaMattress.com, with a 100-night trial and 10-year warranty. Its affiliate program runs on Awin and is pitched at sleep, home-decor and wellness publishers and reviewers.

evidence.summary: Aviya's own Awin merchant profile (the brand's network program page) fetched in full: headline 'Partner with Aviya Mattress: Premium Hybrid Comfort, Uncapped Earnings' and the benefits table states 'High Base Commission — Earn competitive, uncapped payouts on every referred sale', with a 30-day tracking cookie, high average order value, a 4.7/5 rating and a 100-night trial. The explicit uncapped-earnings statements on the brand's own network profile make the commission cap UNCAPPED. The profile publishes no percentage, so the rate comes from the listing evidence below.

Lasso's Aviya program listing reports a 10% per-sale commission rate. A Shopper listing separately reports a 10-20% payout range; the 10% figure is the one the dedicated program listing states as the rate, so commission_rate is recorded as 10 with the range noted here.

The same Awin profile invites review platforms, YouTube review channels and interior-design publications to discuss performance-based tier increases, exclusive audience promo codes and product samples for hands-on testing, and publishes the affiliate manager's direct email: nick@aviyamattress.com.

opportunity.title: Aviya Mattress Affiliate Program — uncapped payouts per the brand's Awin profile, 30-day cookie, manager nick@aviyamattress.com

reasons.niche_fit: Hybrid mattresses are a core home/sleep UGC review category and Aviya's innerspring-vs-foam angle gives creators a clear comparison hook
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program explicitly courts YouTube reviewers and offers product samples for hands-on testing, though it is framed for review publishers rather than social-first creators
reasons.compensation: Explicit uncapped payouts on the brand's own network profile plus a reported 10% rate on a high-AOV mattress; tier increases negotiable for top performers
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate manager's direct email (nick@aviyamattress.com) is published on the program profile, plus the Awin application
reasons.opportunity_availability: Standard Awin application; custom collaborations are aimed at higher-traffic review platforms
reasons.credibility: Established DTC mattress brand with a 4.7/5 rating and full program terms published on its network profile

name: XGIMI
description: Global projector brand (10 years in projectors) selling home and portable smart projectors through its official stores, including us.xgimi.com. Its affiliate program is open to forums, bloggers, influencers, reviewers and content creators, who earn commission on every referred sale.

evidence.summary: XGIMI's official US affiliate guide page fetched: the program is open to 'Forums, bloggers, influencers, reviewers, content creators and more', links to its Impact and Awin program pages, and publishes the program email affiliate@xgimi.com. The page's FAQ (as indexed from the same official page) states the terms: commission on the product's official price, a 30-day cookie window, payment 60 days after a successful purchase, monthly payouts, free to join — and answers the earnings question directly: 'There's no cap on commissions — the more you promote, the more you earn!' The explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page makes the commission cap UNCAPPED.

XGIMI's official global affiliate guide fetched in full: affiliates register on ShareASale, applications are approved automatically, and the published benefits are '5% Commission — 5% commission on sales', a 30-day cookie window, and commission paid within 60 days of a completed order. The 5% rate from the brand's own guide is the recorded rate; a third-party influencer directory's 'up to 10%' claim is not credited over the brand's own published figure.

opportunity.title: XGIMI Affiliate Program — 'no cap on commissions' per official US guide FAQ, 5% per global guide, via ShareASale (Impact/Awin also linked from US store)

reasons.niche_fit: Smart projectors are a highly demonstrable tech product for home-theatre, gaming and room-tour content
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program explicitly welcomes influencers, reviewers and content creators and supplies banners, coupons and content resources
reasons.compensation: Explicit 'no cap on commissions' statement on the brand's own US page; the rate itself is a modest 5% per the global guide
reasons.contact_access: Dedicated program email (affiliate@xgimi.com) published on the US guide page, plus network applications
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are approved automatically on ShareASale per the global guide — the lowest-friction entry in this batch
reasons.credibility: A decade-old global projector brand with official stores and programs on three major networks

name: Yogasleep
description: US sleep-wellness brand founded in 1962, inventor of the original Dohm sound machine, selling sound machines, mattresses and sleep accessories through Yogasleep.com. Its affiliate program runs through Awin and partners with content creators, publishers and sleep experts.

evidence.summary: Official Yogasleep Ambassador Program page fetched in full: affiliates apply through Awin and earn 10% commission on all sound machine sales (Dohm, Dohm Classic and digital multi-sound products) with a 90-day cookie window and monthly payouts through Awin. Mattresses pay a FLAT per-sale commission instead — $65 base per sale, rising with monthly volume bonuses to $90 (11-30 sales), $115 (31-50) and $215 (51+) per sale — a flat bounty structure recorded here, with the 10% sound-machine rate recorded as the percentage rate. The page makes no statement about an earnings cap, so the cap is unknown.

The same official page is creator-facing throughout: it names parenting and family creators, health and wellness advocates, home and lifestyle reviewers and digital publishers as partner types, offers a media toolkit and brand portal assets, and invites qualified partners to request sample sound machines or mattresses for review via marketing@yogasleep.com.

opportunity.title: Yogasleep Affiliate Program — 10% on sound machines plus flat $65-$215 per mattress via Awin, 90-day cookie

reasons.niche_fit: Sound machines and sleep products are a staple home/parenting UGC category, with the nursery and bedtime-routine angles especially strong
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator-facing program page naming creator types, with sample products for review and a media toolkit
reasons.compensation: 10% on sound machines plus flat mattress payouts rising to $215 per sale at volume; no cap statement published
reasons.contact_access: Awin application plus a published team email (marketing@yogasleep.com) for sample and partnership requests
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application through Awin takes under two minutes per the brand, with immediate link access once approved
reasons.credibility: Founded 1962, inventor of the Dohm, clinician-recommended, with over a million families as customers

Widely quoted 4% figures trace to Chewy Canada's separate contract and older Partnerize/CJ routes, and one directory's flat '$15 per sale' claim conflicts with the network template — the US Impact template's 1% is the recorded rate with those conflicts noted here.

opportunity.title: Chewy Affiliate Program — 1% on online sales via Impact (US template), 15-day window, plus a separate Creator Track
